plan.notes: NOTE: Dallas College's catalog site (catalog.dallascollege.edu) returned HTTP 403 to the research fetcher, so the complete semester-by-semester course sequence was taken from the official Guided Pathways (GPS) page, which the page itself labels 'Catalog Year 2026-2027'. The GPS page states: 'This is not an official degree plan. See the catalog for official degree requirements.' The following are prerequisite courses for MATH 2413.
